name: convertGiftToStars
description: Converts a given regular gift to Telegram Stars. Requires the _can\_convert\_gifts\_to\_stars_ business bot right. Returns _True_ on success.

parameters.name: business_connection_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the business connection

parameters.name: owned_gift_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the regular gift that should be converted to Telegram Stars
